checks.rule: Normal acceleration, cap, braking time and stopping distance are measured

input.script: Gas for 4 s, then Brake for 2 s on an unbounded flat plane.

checks.expected: At 1 s speed=24 m/s and distance=12.1 m; normal cap=53.6448 m/s; stop takes 1.491666667 s and 39.74562 m, without reversing.

checks.rule: Opposite steering produces mirrored paths at every FPS
checks.expected: Left/right positions, headings, wheel angles and distances mirror to within 1e-10; both move forward initially.

checks.rule: Steering holds ramp only after the reference delay and clear on release or reversal

input.script: Start at 20 m/s; hold left 0.5 s, continue 0.8 s, release one tick, hold and reverse.

checks.expected: No held gain at 0.5 s; full +20% gain at 1.3 s; hold timer clears on release and restarts at one tick on reversal.

checks.rule: Analog steering strength is preserved without adding a speed-target shortcut

input.script: At 20 m/s apply 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 steering for 0.25 s, before held gain begins.

checks.expected: Wheel response scales in 1:2:4 proportion. Positive pedal magnitude retains original button acceleration rather than a fractional top-speed target.

checks.rule: Coasting cannot add energy and lateral grip decays at its measured rate

input.script: Release inputs for 1 s from forward=20 m/s and sideways=8 m/s.

checks.expected: Kinetic-speed squared never increases; sideways speed after one second equals 8*exp(-7); grip never shifts the kart toward a track center.

checks.rule: A held boost grants one bounded activation and returns gradually to normal speed

input.script: Start at normal cap, hold granted boost + Gas for 5 s, then release/repress boost.

checks.expected: Peak reaches 80.4672 m/s; the held command does not refill its timer; after 5 s speed is normal cap; releasing/repressing activates a new 2-second boost.

checks.rule: A boost press shorter than one physics tick is retained

input.script: Press boost for 1/240 s, release for 1/240 s.

checks.expected: Exactly one physics tick executes and starts boost; the release does not lose the pending press.

checks.rule: Jittered frames and 250 ms catch-up preserve the same timeline

input.script: 12 s of tick-timed accelerate/tap/boost/brake/reverse; compare fixed 30/60/120/144 FPS, alternating 1/55,1/144,1/30,1/240, and 0.25 s batches.

checks.expected: All state fields match within 1e-10, with exactly 1440 physics ticks and no discarded elapsed time.

checks.rule: Render interpolation is smooth and never advances physics

input.script: Advance 0.1 s, sample 101 fractions between the last two fixed states; try to modify the returned pose.

checks.expected: Interpolated travel is continuous and bounded between physics ticks; snapshots are immutable; simulation state/clock remain unchanged.

checks.rule: Invalid time, controls, world data and scripts cannot corrupt the controller

input.script: Submit NaN/infinite/negative/oversized time, malformed input, invalid initial state, bad surface heights, and a script failing midway through a catch-up batch.

checks.expected: All invalid operations throw, state/clock stay unchanged after failed batches, and a subsequent valid step still works.

checks.rule: Reset clears momentum, clock remainder and queued boost without changing track data

input.script: Advance 1/240 s with boost queued, reset onto an elevated track start, then advance one tick with no input.

checks.expected: All motion and timers reset; no old boost fires; track geometry remains byte-identical.

checks.rule: Both road levels remain seated at every captured overpass

input.script: Place a stopped kart on each lower and upper source crossing, then brake for 0.25 s.

checks.expected: Every kart stays grounded on its initial deck; zero false lifts to an upper road and height error below 1e-8 m.

checks.rule: Rigidly placed island tracks preserve handling and support

input.script: Drive 1 s from the same Original start before/after translation (500,70,-900) and yaw=0.73.

checks.expected: Rotating/translating the road and initial pose produces the same local kart trajectory, wheel rotation, pitch and bank to within 1e-8.

checks.rule: No hidden wall collision, route centering or floor exists in this layer

input.script: Drive across the checked Original road edge and out over empty space for 2 s.

checks.expected: Kart crosses the edge according to its inputs and falls under gravity; it is never snapped back to the road or placed on an artificial floor.

checks.rule: Airborne wheels and stopped steering cannot turn the chassis

input.script: Full steering while parked for 1 s, then at 12 m/s in unsupported air for 1 s; compare forward and reverse steering.

checks.expected: Parked/airborne heading change is zero. The same wheel input reverses the direction of chassis turning when backing up.

checks.rule: Wheel rotation measures actual forward and reverse travel

input.script: Drive straight in forward/reverse for 2 s, and drift sideways for 1 s.

checks.expected: wheelRotation * 0.38 equals signed forward travel; sideways-only drift does not roll the wheels.

checks.rule: Clamped input, immutable snapshots and independent controllers protect shared callers

input.script: Clamp steering/throttle outside [-1,1], try mutating state and control snapshots, alter the caller initial pose after construction, then reset.

checks.expected: Controls clamp to [-1,1]; caller objects remain unchanged; snapshots reject mutation; reset retains the original copied pose; a second controller is unaffected.

checks.rule: A seeded one-minute mixed-input stress trace stays bounded and repeatable

input.script: 60 s; change seeded throttle, steering, brake and granted boost every 30 physics ticks; use seed 0x415120.

checks.expected: All fields remain finite, steering remains within 0.498 rad, reverse never exceeds 8 m/s, speed never exceeds the 180 mph cap, and all FPS results match to 1e-10.

checks.rule: Fresh handling is strict TypeScript with no browser, graphics or prototype dependencies

input.script: Compile kart/tsconfig.json with ES2022 only and no ambient types; inspect imports.

checks.expected: Strict compilation passes and runtime imports no DOM/Three/old racing or motion modules.
